competitors.name: DiGiorno
competitors.action: Prepared Foods reported Nestle extended DiGiorno with four Wood Fired Style Crust offerings, pushing harder into texture-led premiumization with a crisp, chewy, charred crust story.

competitors.name: PORTA
competitors.action: Prepared Foods highlighted PORTA extending its flash-frozen Roman-style pinsa line with Sweet & Spicy Soppressata, reinforcing that imported Italian ingredients and premium crust formats are still gaining attention in frozen retail.

competitors.name: Michaels of Brooklyn
competitors.action: Foodbevy reported the brand launched a small-batch premium pizza sauce at The Fresh Market, extending restaurant credibility into take-home pizza occasions beyond the frozen pie itself.

trends.topic: At-home pizza premiumization is broadening from frozen pies into full pizza-occasion CPG
trends.magnitude: Prepared Foods and Foodbevy both point to premium crust, imported ingredients, and restaurant-led pantry extensions in April 2026
trends.context: The signal is not just more frozen pizza SKUs. Winning brands are building a stronger quality story around crust texture, Italian sourcing, and restaurant credibility, then expanding into adjacent products that help own the full at-home pizza moment.

breaking.headline: Texture and authenticity are becoming the clearest premium frozen-pizza battlegrounds
breaking.impact: Real Dough should keep leaning into a distinct crust story and avoid generic premium claims. The freezer aisle is rewarding products that can explain why their bite, chew, char, or sourcing is meaningfully different.
